title: Bronchitis in Dogs
category: Lung and Airway Disorders of Dogs
author: Ned F. Kuehn , DVM, MS, DACVIM , Michigan Veterinary Specialists
content:
## Overview
Bronchitis is an inflammation of the bronchial airways that may extend into the lungs. It is discussed in this chapter as part of tracheobronchitis .
Also see professional content regarding tracheobronchitis .
